eas_text: A civil authority has issued A REQUIRED MONTHLY TEST for the following counties or areas: Amelia; Caroline; Charles City; Chesterfield; Colonial Heights city; Dinwiddie; Emporia city; Essex; Goochland; Greensville; Hanover; Henrico; Hopewell city; King William; King and Queen; Lancaster; Louisa; Middlesex; New Kent; Northumberland; Petersburg city; Powhatan; Prince George; Richmond city; Richmond; Sussex; Westmoreland, VA; at 10:14 PM on AUG 12, 2013 Effective until 11:14 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
